serial_suite: ui-tsp/e2e/native-settings.e2e.ts remains the 10-test serial suite; explorers must not share its pane

charters.goal: Starting at the isolated Hermes Settings sheet, visit every visible page once, search by exact field key, and read native_schema plus native_settings. Report only observe/locate/schema evidence. Do not toggle, save, confirm, or type a secret. Empty search must not appear on native_wire as settings.set. Escape clears query.

Exercise only scalars: display.show_reasoning, agent.max_turns, display.resume_display, agent.environment_hint. Confirm with native_settings and native_config_bytes. Restore before close. Cancel if a confirm sheet appears.

Edit only toolsets and agent.reasoning_overrides. Invalid JSON must warn with zero settings.set on native_wire. Valid list/object persist then Use default or Unset. Do not touch execution/privacy/provider keys.

Open session.model picker Models, confirm no global action, Escape to restore owner. Attempt terminal.backend docker, auth.adopt_external_logins, model, telemetry.shared_metrics.send and tap Cancel (default) only. native_wire must show zero confirmed true and zero denied if you stayed Cancel-only.

Type a unicode draft, move caret, open and close Settings. Use native_hold/native_release around settings.set on display.show_reasoning to prove rapid reversion and replacement owners. native_wire held then delivered. Do not prompt.submit.

native_corrupt_inert then open Settings, expect Retry, native_restore_inert, Retry succeeds. Use visible /new only if on screen, check Thinking effort and Session lead. Do not write foreign profiles. native_restore_inert before close.
